description: The National Map - Data Delivery is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGS, United States Geological Survey. Explore an array of data and information that can help you access maps relevant for your location. Tools ion the site nclude The National Map Viewer, LidarExplorer, topoView - Historical Topo Maps, and more. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Landslides, Wildfire. Assets: Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
